text:
It prefers orders by post.

Nevmore Outfitters quotes 50 per unit, delivers in 13 days, and holds a rating of 8 out of 10. Its warehouse is near the river.

Zelmore Traders quotes 175 per unit, delivers in 6 days, and holds a rating of 1 out of 10. It has traded for many years.

Istmore Outfitters quotes 150 per unit, delivers in 2 days, and holds a rating of 9 out of 10. Its office closes early on market days.

Zelstead Works quotes 70 per unit, delivers in 9 days, and holds a rating of 5 out of 10. Its warehouse is near the river.

Morstead Cooperative quotes 45 per unit, delivers in 13 days, and holds a rating of 5 out of 10. Its warehouse is near the river.

Dovstead Supply quotes 180 per unit, delivers in 5 days, and holds a rating of 10 out of 10. Its office closes early on market days.

Which supplier quotes at most 150 per unit, delivers within 11 days and is rated at least 6 out of 10?
